skill_name: Predict the 2021 wildfire season in California.
workflow: The 2021 wildfire season in California is expected to be active and bring about an early start to some areas as a result of recent drought conditions. This will likely cause more extensive damage than in previous years due to the dry conditions. Conditions this season will be further magnified by a potential increase in extreme weather events such as strong winds, dry lightning and low humidity, in addition to potential higher temperatures.
